O David’s Son, and David’s Lord
O David’s Son, and David’s Lord!
From age to age thou art the same;
And teach our youth to know thy name!
No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Newton printed the hymn under 1 Chronicles 28:9. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

As for you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve Him wholeheartedly and with a willing mind, for the LORD searches every heart and understands the intent of every thought. If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will reject you forever. 1 CHRONICLES 28:9 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ 1 CHRONICLES 28
O David’s Son, and David’s Lord! From age to age thou art the same; Thy gracious presence now afford, And teach our youth to know thy name! STANZA I
